title: Monolith catalog extraction

expected_evidence_facts.fact: The gateway routes catalog traffic to the catalog service and fallback traffic to the commerce monolith.
The monolith and catalog service both connect to the existing commerce database.
Catalog write cutover and schema ownership are not approved.

critical_unresolved_decisions.question: Which application owns catalog writes in the current diagram?
critical_unresolved_decisions.why_it_matters: Routing only establishes catalog reads, not write ownership.

critical_unresolved_decisions.question: Will the catalog service keep sharing the commerce database or receive its own store?
critical_unresolved_decisions.why_it_matters: The target data boundary is unresolved.

critical_unresolved_decisions.question: If data ownership changes, how will old and new representations synchronize during cutover?
critical_unresolved_decisions.why_it_matters: No event bus, CDC, or dual-write mechanism is evidenced.

critical_unresolved_decisions.question: What is the rollback point if the extracted path fails?
critical_unresolved_decisions.why_it_matters: The current configuration gives no migration rollback behavior.

forbidden_unsupported_assumptions: An event bus or CDC pipeline
